title: Rabbi Elazar bar Yishmael
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tosefta Terumot 9:6, but the Tosefta manuscript reads Rabbi Shimon ben Elazar. And what is found in Terumot 11:2, “Rabbi Prigori of Caesarea said that Rabbi Lazar son of Rabbi Yishmael said,” Hyman proposes reading there “Rabbi Lazar said, in accordance with Rabbi Yishmael.”

notes.text: The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 11:2 has Liezer bei Rabbi Yishmael. Hyman proposes reading the phrase as a comparison with Rabbi Yishmael. The Tosefta manuscript variant is Hyman’s report.
